bead.title: Enforce tenant-scoped Kafka ACLs
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The Kafka surface must deny reads outside the caller's tenant and queue namespace.
ROOT CAUSE: The repo has tenant-aware queue identity in the core, but no Kafka ACL test or authorization bridge for the embedded surface.
PROPOSED FIX: Enforce tenant-prefixed topic access and deny-by-default ACL scoping so a caller can only read its own `(tenant_id, queue_id)` change stream.
NON-SCOPE: Dependency pinning, ordered emission, and consumer-group ownership are handled by sibling beads.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestKafkaTenantAclRejectsCrossTenantRead` proves the Kafka surface is tenant-scoped and denies a caller outside its `(tenant_id, queue_id)` namespace.
2. `go test ./... -run 'TestKafkaTenantAclRejectsCrossTenantRead'`\n3. `lefthook run pre-commit`\n4. `lefthook run pre-push`
